args.prompt: FAST hops down the step. FAST steps off the bus in a crisp varsity jacket with an 'RL' patch, grinning; SLOW waits at the stop with his notebook, a small relieved smile. Camera: Medium two-shot. 1990s cel anime; color and monochrome ink wash bleeding into each other. Keep the art style, characters, faces, hair, outfits and any lettering exactly as in the first frame. Characters do not speak or sing; mouths stay closed or relaxed. No new text or subtitles.
args.negative_prompt: 3D render, CGI, photorealistic, morphing, warped faces, extra limbs, extra people, subtitles, captions, watermark, text changes
